status: new causal-geometry scaffold preregistered before run
scope_warning: the causal relation signature is explicitly constructed from action→body transition pairs. Success demonstrates how a continuous internal relation geometry can support generalization; it does not show that such a geometry emerged spontaneously in the original reactor.

diagnostic_basis.result: static viability optimum was exactly w*=-phi for every relation in all 8 seeds; mean and median angular error 0 deg
diagnostic_basis.separate_learning_diagnostic: stepwise scalar eligibility learning was insufficiently reliable and is not used in the confirmatory geometry test

architecture: C4 + finite maintenance reserve; no relation-memory slots in GEOMETRIC condition
relation_dynamics: body action is transformed by a hidden shared 4D block rotation R4(phi)

recognition.policy: neutral orientation w=0 for every condition
recognition.same_trajectory: recognition is run once per seed×relation; every condition forks from the identical post-recognition state, integrity and reserve
recognition.causal_signature: from each transition compute y=-[s_post-As*s_pre-.25*e_post]/.40; accumulate dot(a,y) and planar cross(a,y) over both 2D body pairs; phi_hat=atan2(sum_cross,sum_dot)

conditions.NEAREST4: quantize phi_hat to nearest anchor relation {-135,-45,45,135}; use inverse of that anchor
conditions.SHUFFLED_PAIR: compute phi_hat after deterministically permuting consequence vectors y across recognition times while preserving action and consequence marginals; w=-phi_hat_shuffled

evaluation.maintenance: finite reserve, same rule as previous scaffold

primary_metrics.mean_viability: mean V over 150 post-recognition steps averaged across four branches

primary_hypotheses.H1: mean recognition error <5 deg AND >90% of seed×relation units have error<10 deg
primary_hypotheses.H4: per-seed oracle_gap <0.01 on average, with bootstrap 95% upper bound <0.02

tests: H2-H3 one-sided sign-flip across 64 seeds with Holm correction; >60% positive seeds and bootstrap lower bound >0. H1/H4 use preregistered threshold criteria.
secondary_diagnostics: pairwise code distance vs true angular distance
interpretation_rule: success supports a continuous causal relation geometry that can recognize an unseen action-body transformation and immediately generate near-oracle behavior, outperforming categorical nearest-memory retrieval. It is causal system identification/generalization, not consciousness and not spontaneous latent geometry.
